meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: Claude 会召集一个由多种思维原型组成的“意识委员会”，围绕你的问题让每个成员用各自的视角给出立场、理由、风险和洞察，最后汇总成一份包含共识点、核心分歧、盲点、建议路径和信心程度的综合结论。
howto.when: 当你要求多角度思考、面临两难抉择、请求委员会式讨论，或提到 “council mode”“mind council” 等触发词时触发。

say.text: 帮我用委员会模式分析一下：我该不该跳槽？
say.note: 会召集多位思维角色从不同立场审议你的问题。

say.text: 用快议模式，三个人来讨论这个产品方案。
say.note: 快速议会，3位成员、更简短的回复。

say.text: 开启魔鬼代言人模式，挑战我辞职创业的想法。
say.note: 每位成员都会反对最直觉的立场。

howto.what_en: Claude will summon a "mind council" of thinking archetypes, each giving their stance, reasoning, risks, and insights, then synthesize a conclusion with convergence points, core tension, blind spot, recommended path, and confidence level.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want diverse viewpoints, face a dilemma, request a council-style discussion, or say trigger phrases like "council mode" etc.

say_en.text: Use council mode to analyze: should I switch jobs?
say_en.note: Summons multiple thinking roles to review your question from different stances.

say_en.text: Quick council: three roles discuss this product plan.
say_en.note: Fast deliberation with 3 members and shorter replies.

say_en.text: Devil's advocate mode: challenge my idea to quit and start a company.
say_en.note: Every member argues against whatever seems most intuitive.
